collection.title: Robert M. Gates Subject Files: Middle East Economic Strategy [1]
collection.methodology: Selected-file audit only. The first PDF page controls provenance. Every served-PDF page was mapped to the opening inventory, later release sheets, listed documents, or unlisted released pages; document candidates were then deduplicated against the harvested Deal Chronological and H-Files NSC Meetings collections.

fileUnits.title: Middle East - Economic Strategy [1]
fileUnits.dateBasis: Dated document span established by page-level audit
fileUnits.chapter: Monetary Policy, Debt, and International Institutions
fileUnits.archivalLocator: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, Robert M. Gates Files, Subject Files, OA/ID CF00946–002, Middle East - Economic Strategy [1].
fileUnits.provenanceStem: Source: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, Robert M. Gates Files, Subject Files, OA/ID CF00946–002, Middle East - Economic Strategy [1].
fileUnits.reviewFocus: Read the Brady memorandum, the financing and debt papers, the annotated Deal-to-Gates memoranda, and the country-paper set. Compare the August 29 NSC packet against the H-Files and compare Deal memoranda against the sender's chronological files before selecting a controlling copy.
fileUnits.reviewKeyExtent: 125 served-PDF pages fully accounted for: 1 opening marker, 3 opening inventory sheets, 3 later individual redaction sheets, 113 pages for 23 listed items, 3 unlisted Treasury transmittal/paper pages, and 2 unlisted NSC agenda/participant pages. All 23 listed items have copies in the current PDF; items 05a and 05c are released in part.
